column1: # Hand-written corrections applied by scripts/gen_maps.py on top of VarCon.
#   pair    <american> <british> [<oxford>]   add a pair in both directions
#   ize     <stem...>              add the whole -ize/-ise family of a stem (tokenize ...)
# This file is original work for this spike (word pairs are facts); no third-party licence.
# "spelt" is also the cereal ("spelt flour"); "spilt" / "spoilt" are accepted adjectives in the US
# Scotch whisky / Irish whiskey depend on the origin of the drink, not on the dialect
# "prized possession" must not become "prised possession"; "come to naught" is British too
# junk or risky pairs from unverified VarCon clusters
# "prise open" -> US "pry open"; VarCon's "prize open" is correct but reads like an error
# correct but the result can read as a slur; leave these rare words alone
# tsar/czar: both are used in American English
# mom/mum, ass/arse are vocabulary, not spelling: the vocabulary layer decides
# everyday / technical words missing from VarCon
# VarCon's porer/pourer row is junk ("pourer" is the same word everywhere)
